title: Delta weight-and-balance system outage briefly halts Atlanta-bound flights
date_note: Fox News says the outage happened on Sunday morning, 22 November, the day of its article; no clock time given.
geo_basis: Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport, named by Fox News
summary: An outage of Delta Air Lines' automated weight-and-balance system on Sunday morning led the FAA to briefly halt Atlanta-bound flights, Fox News reported, saying at least 3,500 Delta flights were reportedly delayed; Tengrinews reported delays to more than 1,600. Delta said the system had not been hacked, according to ABC News as relayed by Tengrinews, which reported automated systems were restored on Sunday afternoon after manual workarounds.
plain: A Delta system that works out aircraft weight before take-off failed on Sunday and the FAA briefly stopped flights to Atlanta. Reports put delays at at least 3,500 or more than 1,600 flights. Delta said, per ABC News, it was not hacked.
exec: A failure in one airline system reportedly delayed at least 3,500 Delta flights, Fox News said; Delta said, per ABC News, it was not hacked.

evidence.quote: has reportedly delayed at least 3,500 Delta flights across major hubs
On Sunday, November 22, an equipment outage in Atlanta caused delays to more than 1,600 Delta flights.
The airline said the system had not been hacked, according to ABC News.

key_findings: Delta's automated weight-and-balance system failed on Sunday morning
The FAA briefly halted Atlanta-bound flights
Delta said teams were using manual workarounds
Tengrinews, citing ABC News, says Delta stated the system had not been hacked; it reports automated systems were restored on Sunday afternoon

validation.note: Corroborated by two independent publishers, foxnews.com and en.tengrinews.kz, each stating the core fact: Fox News (Delta's statement on manual workarounds; 'reportedly' at least 3,500 delayed) and Tengrinews (more than 1,600 delayed; Delta's 'not hacked' statement credited to ABC News; restoration on Sunday afternoon). Tengrinews' headline says more than 1,000 cancelled but its body reports only delays, so no cancellation figure is used. ABC News itself was not read.

review.note: Compared title, date, outage category, 3,500 reportedly and 1,600 figures, FAA halt, not-hacked statement credited to ABC, afternoon restoration against Fox News and Tengrinews
